Native OCR components

Tesseract 5.5.5 (Apache-2.0) and Leptonica 1.87.0 (BSD-2-Clause) supply
the OCR engine. Source archive URLs and hashes are in vendor/ocr.lock.json.
The direct source build uses the LSTM engine, baseline target CPU and
Leptonica PNM input. The application passes rendered page pixels in PNM
format. The Simplified Chinese and English language files are from the
Apache-2.0 tessdata_fast project and carry runtime/tessdata/LICENSE.

The release build used Zig 0.14.1 with LLVM/Clang. Compiler runtime code
is MIT (Zig-LICENSE.txt). C++ runtime components include LLVM libc++,
libc++abi and libunwind under Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception and their
accompanying notices, reproduced in LLVM-*-LICENSE.txt. The Linux binaries
link musl statically (musl-COPYRIGHT.txt). Windows uses the MinGW-w64 CRT
and the operating system's own libraries. See MinGW-w64-COPYING.txt and
MinGW-runtime-additional-notices.txt. No VC redistributable is installed
by the OCR component.

The upstream Python wheels remain intact. Their .dist-info license files
carry their respective authors' notices, including third-party codec and
rendering components. This product includes software developed by the
FreeType Project (www.freetype.org) under the FreeType License, and is
based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group. OpenSSL and
libffi notices accompany the cryptography and cffi wheels in this folder.
